description: The pilot's link-dependencies helper ignored EEXIST, while GitWorkspaces precreates an empty node_modules directory. Department Author therefore saw no tools and self-installed declared dependencies with npm --no-save --no-package-lock. Native received an actual dependency junction from setup.
evidence: Department agent:author logs at 2026-10-24T02:51:05Z; installed directory timestamps around 02:51:16-35Z.
intervention: No runtime or source edit was made to rescue this. Author completed its own package installation. Wall time includes this provisioning difference and must not be attributed entirely to multi-agent overhead.
limits: Same declared tool versions, different installation layout. This pilot is not a rigorously equal-environment benchmark.
